c1_fact: The repository indicates it exposes an MCP server (noted by the 'mcp-name' comment and 'AI Agent Skill' / 'OpenClaw Skill' badges) which can be called from TypeScript via the MCP protocol. It also provides a Python SDK.
c2_fact: As a Python package published on PyPI, it can be installed and run on a GitHub Actions Ubuntu runner. It includes 'Fetchers' which support headless browser navigation for live websites without external infrastructure.
c4_fact: While exact install size and dependency count are not specified in the README, Python scraping libraries with headless browser support (like Playwright/Selenium) typically have a moderate footprint. Setup involves installing the package and browser binaries, which is generally feasible within a 2-3 minute time limit on a GitHub Actions runner.
